title: Marketplace legal & tech dependencies + copy slate
content:
Purpose and scope:
This is a working playbook for partner listings in cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, GCP). Focus areas: legal attachments & required terms, technical dependencies (networking, billing SKUs, entitlements), and a short slate of copy variations to use in catalog metadata and marketing tiles. This doc is intended for partnership managers + solutions engineers + legal reviewer.

Status and usage notes:
- Draft: internal review with product + legal + infra required before sending to marketplace vendor.
- Use these templates as input to the marketplace portal UI; keep versions of final copy in the repo linked above.
- Where a field differs by marketplace (example: GCP tile character limits), note the variant in the field line.

Owners and point people:
- Listing owner: Asha Patel (go-to-market) — primary submit contact
- Tech validation: Liam O'Connor (solutions eng) — tests connectivity, auth, entitlements
- Security/compliance sign-off: Priya Singh (security & compliance) — certs & PCI/SOC status
- Legal attachments: Diego Morales (legal) — contract templates, DPA references

Required legal attachments (checklist):
- DPA (data processing agreement) PDF, company-stamped — required for enterprise listings
- SOC 2 Type II report or attestation summary (or timeline for completion if in progress)
- Third-party data processing disclosures (if using partner telemetry)
- Product Terms / Marketplace addendum (short one-page summary that maps Redwood pricing model to marketplace terms)
- If offering private deployment: optional on-prem license agreement draft + support SOW example

Tech & infra prerequisites (high level checklist):
- Model runtime compatibility: specify supported model families and quantization variants (e.g., gpt-like, transformerXL, 4-bit quantized builds). Include tested sequence lengths and perf profiles.
- Network & VPC requirements: list of inbound/outbound ports, allowed CIDR ranges for vendor agents, and whether partner requires a site-to-site VPN or peering.
- Authentication: OAuth/OIDC or API key flow? Document required claims and token TTLs. If Marketplace requires OAuth flow, include redirect URI patterns.
- Billing SKU mapping: canonical SKU names, meter granularity (per-token vs per-request vs per-inference minute), and suggested marketplace SKU labels.
- Entitlements & usage metering hooks: endpoints for usage reports, required payload schema, and frequency (daily/hourly).
- Data residency options: list supported regions and any data-at-rest encryption details (KMS/HSM).
- Logging & telemetry: which logs we surface (request id, latency, failure reason) and any PII redaction guidance.
- Security scanning: required static/dynamic scan artifacts or attestations, container image digest and signed SBOM.

Marketplace submission fields & constraints (example mapping):
- Product name (max 60 chars): Redwood Inference — Hosted LLM Inference
- Short description (max 140 chars): High-performance, low-latency LLM inference with flexible deployment: hosted, dedicated, and private.
- Long description (no hard limit but prefer 1–3 short paragraphs): use the long-copy template below.
- Key features (bullets, up to 6): listing of short bullets; each bullet < 200 chars for most portals.
- Categories / tags: AI/ML, Inference, Infrastructure, Enterprise-ready
- Pricing models: usage-based, reserved capacity (commits), enterprise license (private) — note to map to marketplace billing APIs
- Support level: email + chat (standard), phone escalation (enterprise), SLA references (link to SLA PDF)

Acceptance/QA checklist before submit:
- Copy approved by growth/content (Maya Chen).
- Legal artifacts uploaded and verified.
- Tech validation: run full acceptance test suite against marketplace staging endpoints (ticket MKP-3456).
- Images: ensure tile and banner images meet resolution guidelines below and pass visual review.
- SKU test: create test purchase in sandbox, validate usage reporting.
- Link verification: all external links resolve and use https.

Image/asset requirements (common):
- Tile icon: square PNG, 1024x1024, transparent background recommended, max 2MB.
- Banner/hero image: 1600x600 (or per marketplace spec), JPEG/PNG, sRGB color profile, max 3MB.
- Screenshots: 1280x720 recommended, include 3–5 product screenshots showing console, latency graphs, and deployment options.
- Logos for publishers: SVG preferred + PNG fallback.

SKU naming conventions (recommended):
- Keep SKU tokens short and machine-friendly: redwood.hosted.per-token, redwood.dedicated.monthly, redwood.private.license
- Metering units: tokens, embedding-units, inference-minutes.
- Example marketplace mapping: marketplace_sku_id -> redwood.hosted.per-token -> unit: token -> rate-tiered (first 1M @ $0.0003, next 9M @ $0.00025)

Copy slate: short, medium, and long variants for product description
- Short (for catalog tile, ~120 char):
  "Redwood Inference: high-throughput LLM serving with predictable latency, flexible deployment (hosted, dedicated, private), and built-in cost controls."
- Medium (for hero tile, ~250 char):
  "Ship LLM-powered features reliably with Redwood Inference. Our high-performance serving runtime, unified API, and deployment choices (hosted, reserved, private) help engineering teams hit latency and cost targets while keeping operations simple."
- Long (for long description / marketplace detail page):
  "Redwood Inference is a developer-first inference platform that makes it easy to run and scale LLMs in production. We combine a GPU-optimized runtime, intelligent batching and caching, and a single API that works across hosted, reserved and private deployments. Engineers get transparent performance profiles, token-level cost breakdowns, and rollout controls (canaries, A/B, automatic fallbacks). Choose Redwood for predictable latency, lower unit costs through batching and quantization suggestions, and enterprise controls including VPC/private install and audit-ready logs."

Call-to-action variants (choose one depending on marketplace CTA constraints):
- Try free trial — start in minutes
- Request enterprise demo and SLA options
- Contact sales for dedicated capacity pricing

Short bullets for feature grid (6 bullets):
- Low-latency GPU runtime with kernel-level optimizations
- Unified REST + SDKs for generation, chat, embeddings, reranking
- Dedicated pools & reserved capacity for predictable throughput
- Private deployment options (VPC / on-prem) and KMS/HSM integrations
- Built-in observability: token-level cost + latency breakdowns
- Optimize toolkit: batching, quantization suggestions, and quality monitors

Marketplace-specific notes and gotchas:
- AWS: final tile copy must include AMI or CloudFormation artifact if offering private AMI; pay careful attention to AWS listing rules about pricing display.
- Azure: some SKU mappings require mapping to meter categories in Azure Marketplace; legal attachments often need a publisher agreement signed in the portal.
- GCP: character limits and metadata fields differ; GCP favors a short summary + expandable sections.

Risk & mitigation log (quick):
- Legal review periods can add 2–4 weeks — plan lead time.
- Sandbox billing mismatches — run at least two test purchases per SKU.
- Image rejections for non-compliant color profile — standardize exports from Figma with sRGB preset.

Submission timeline (example sprint plan):
- Week 1: collate legal artifacts & design assets (owner: Diego / Maya)
- Week 2: tech validation + sandbox SKU tests (owner: Liam)
- Week 3: final copy review & marketplace portal submission (owner: Asha)
- Week 4: vendor QA & publish (owner: vendor PM + Asha)

Notes & reminders / open questions:
- Confirm whether marketplace requires a free trial toggle or a paid-only SKU for each region. (action: Asha, slack #marketplace-integrations)
- Do we need a separate SKU for quantized model variants? Possible complexity for metering — discussion required with product. (action: Priya)
- Capture a short how-to for Marketplace support routing — who owns incoming escalations post-publish? (action: Maya)

Appendix: useful links and templates
- Listing copy checklist (template): brief checklist to paste into portal during submit
- Legal attachments template folder: link in repo -> github:repo/legal-templates
- Image export settings: Figma export preset -> sRGB, 72ppi, png/jpg, no metadata

Quick paste-ready copy checklist (to use in portal comments):
- Long desc reviewed by content: yes/no
- Short desc < 140 chars: yes/no
- Images uploaded and sized: yes/no
- SKU IDs mapped to internal rates: yes/no
- DPA & SOC 2 uploaded: yes/no
- Support contact and SLA link present: yes/no

If you make changes here, add an edit note: who, date, brief summary.
